aboutTitle: A much-loved second pairing with silky-soft coats and family-favorite temperaments.
aboutThisLitter: We are so excited to bring Beatrix and Enzo together for their second pairing. Their first pairing gave us so much to love, and we cannot wait to see this combination again.

Beatrix is one of the sweetest mamas in our program. She has an exceptionally silky-soft coat, an affectionate family-dog temperament, and the kind of gentle personality that has made her a true Red Ranch family favorite.

Enzo is a top-notch Goldendoodle stud in our program and consistently produces some of the cutest puppies. His compact size, beautiful red coat, and proven contribution to our Goldendoodle lines make him a special match for Beatrix.

Because Beatrix is an F1 Goldendoodle and Enzo is approximately 96% Poodle and 4% Golden Retriever, their puppies are expected to average about 73% Poodle and 27% Golden Retriever. That gives this Goldendoodle-to-Goldendoodle pairing an F1B-style genetic balance.

Beatrix is now in heat, so breeding is planned for late July to early August. If breeding and pregnancy progress as expected, puppies would be due in late September to early October, with go-home estimated for late November to early December 2026.

We expect warm apricot and red possibilities with silky-soft wavy to curly, lower-shedding coat possibilities. Puppies are expected to mature around 25-35 lbs full-grown, though individual puppy size can vary.
